rules.sectionReferenceMeaning: Use the accepted Latin Niese registry. XI preserves each registered physical occurrence and labels the two accepted Bellum interpolations separately. XII–XV use explicit Niese milestones and unsuppressed source citation labels. Unavailable registry identities do not create records or imply lost Latin text.
rules.textTransformations: Exclude source num labels, notes, heads, trailers, pre-narrative front matter and the exact XII subscription following its explicit niese-end marker. Retain every other running source character, including anonymous narrative paragraphs and all add/del/unclear/corr/expan content. Trim each paragraph fragment edge; join continuing physical paragraphs with two newlines.
rules.phraseBoundaries: Physical source spans preserve actual Latin order. Separate portions of a canonical section share citationUnitId but acquire no artificial adjacency. Zero-width TEI gaps interrupt tokens and phrases. Literal dot/ellipsis clusters and erased punctuation conservatively block adjacency; marginal dots are not interpreted as proof of an omission. Registry-unavailable identities alone introduce no source lacuna or phrase break.
rules.editorialMarkup: Preserve exact add/del/unclear attributes and UTF-16 spans in editorialMarks; corr/expan/s/ref appear in sourceMarkup. Do not silently correct readings, omit marginal source words, or generate display glyphs.
rules.unknownContent: Require the frozen accepted XML and identity-registry hashes, with CRLF/LF equivalence. A changed source, unresolved boundary, overlapping interval, lost running character or unreviewed empty span stops extraction.
rules.sourceProjectionDefinition: Each original narrative paragraph is exactly restored from finished recordId slices plus excluded labels/notes and reversible edge whitespace. Anonymous paragraphs use an explicit xpath: source locator, never an invented XML id.
rules.offsetDefinition: Audit sourceText, flat and recordText coordinates are Python Unicode characters, end exclusive. Published inline marks, textGaps and phraseBreaks use JavaScript UTF-16 offsets.
rules.tokenCountDefinition: Unicode L/N start and L/M/N continuation, with explicit source gap boundaries interrupting token formation.
rules.readerRoute: /antiquities/?book=13&niese={section}; the two registered Bellum interpolations use their accepted association to XI.312.

Latin.note: No independent Latin interval. The full reviewed Latin context has no identifiable counterpart of this section's separate account of Simon's appointment as high priest, liberation from Macedonian tribute and the 170-year chronology. The documentary dating formula within XIII.212 corresponds to Greek XIII.214 and does not supply this liberation account. The earlier military appointment in latin-book13-num201 is a different account. Greek and English remain independently accessible; no cause, physical loss or tradition-wide absence is inferred.

excluded.text: I Qualiter ionathas frater iudae defuncto educatum suscepit.
II Quemadmodum bachidem debellans facere eum amicitias secum et a prouincia coegit abscedere.
III De alexandro epifanis antiochi filio ueniente syria et educente bellum contra demetrium.
IIII Qualiter demetrius legationem ad ionatham transmittens componit cum eo amicitias dona quae ei multa praebuit.
V Quomodo alexander haec audiens et uincens demetrium principem sacerdotum ordinauit.
VI De amicitiis oniae cum filometore ptolomeo per idem tempus et ut aedificauit templum quod oniae dicitur preter illud quod hierosolimis erat.
VII Quemadmodum alexander defuncto demetrio ninus ionathan honorauit.
VIII Ut demetrius demetri filius nauigans in syriam a creta et expugnans alexandrum regnauit amicitias cum ionatha faciens.
VIIII De trifone apameno qui bellans contra demetrium antiocho filio alexandri tradidit principatum componens amicitias cum ionatha.
X Quemadmodum trifon demetrio a partos capto contra foedus fraudibus, ionathan comprehendens interfecit et bellum contra fratre eius simonem eduxit.
XI Qualiter gens iudaeorum simoni ducatum tradidit.
XII Quomodo obsedit trifonem in doris auxilium praebens antiocho demetrii cognomento pio.
XIII Quemadmodum trifone interempto antiochus expugnauit simonem et cendebeum ducem eius uincens a iudea fugauit.
XIIII Quod a genero ptolomei in conuiuio dolo simon peremptus est, ptolomeus autem uinciens uxorem et filios eius principatum ipse tenere conatus est.
XV Ut nouissimuis filiorum simonis yrcanys ducatum accipiens obsedit multo tempore ptolomeum in aliquo castello quod dagon uocatur.
XVI Quemadmodum antiochus exercitum ducens contra hyrcanum castra soluit accipiens ab hyrcano talenta trecenta et amicitias cum eo composuit.
XVII De hyrcani militia post mortem antiochi apud medos defuncti contra syriam et quod multas potentes ciuitates obtinuit.
XVIII De amicitiis alexandri zabinne cognomine cum hyrcano.
XVIIII Quomodo deuictus ab hyrcano antiochus cizicenus amisit iudaeam.
XX Quod suscipiens aristobolus principatum primus sibi diadema imposuit.
XXI Quemadmodum aristobolo frater eius alexander succedens in principatu contra syriam et phoenicem et arabiam exercitum ducens multas gentes subegit.
XXII De ptolomei latiri contra alexandrum uicit eum.

XXIII Antiochi quilibet pater dicebatur milia contra iudeam qualiter eam optinuit. XXV Quemadmodum post alexandri mortem uxor eius alexandra imperium per nouem annos rexit et uiuens cum pace gloria quae defuncta est.EXPLICIUNT CAPITULA
Bamberg Msc. Class. 78
